children: ONE OF GROUP'S OVERSEAS BUSINESS UNITS WAS RECENTLY SUBJECT OF A CYBERSECURITY INCIDENT
UNIT CONDUCTED INVESTIGATION INTO INCIDENT AND MADE RELEVANT NOTIFICATIONS TO AUTHORITIES IN SINGAPORE
CRITICAL SYSTEMS AND BUSINESS DATA OF BUSINESS UNIT HAVE ALSO SINCE BEEN FULLY RECOVERED
NO MATERIAL DISRUPTION TO UNITS' BUSINESS
INCIDENT DID NOT AFFECT ANY OTHER PART OF GROUP EXCEPT FOR BUSINESS UNIT
WILL CONDUCT AN INDEPENDENT CYBERSECURITY REVIEW
